Moss green hair, sparse and patchy with a decayed texture. Pale white eyes with a hollow, mindless expression. Appears as an undead entity with a rotting, skeletal face. Massive, towering build with greyish-blue necrotic skin. Wearing rusted iron plates and tattered remnants of a dark grey military uniform. Features exposed ribcage, stitched flesh, and a massive rusted axe.
BODY COLOR: necrotic grey
